faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Brentwood homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,500 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. The city's newer master-planned communities feature standard sizing that makes replacement efficient and cost-effective. Single windows start at approximately $400–$500 installed.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Yes. The City of Brentwood requires building permits for window replacement projects. Our team handles all permit applications and inspections on your behalf, typically at no additional charge for standard residential projects.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Brentwood commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Brentwood replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Most Brentwood projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
